request.scope: Ingest and synthesize eleven attached artifacts with provenance and review boundaries.

recommendations: Review conflicting economic schemas before selecting a canonical candidate.
Obtain licenses or URLs for named external references.
Require consent-gated retrieval for sensitive content.
Add explicit calculation settings before promoting formulas.
decisions: retain canonical registry ownership in astrology-data-unifi

unresolved_issues.details: Attached formulas do not include complete datetime, timezone, coordinates, zodiac, house system, precision, or ephemeris metadata.
No source URLs or licenses were supplied for the attached texts.
Named bibliography and data providers require independent retrieval and license review.
Asteroid keyword content is source-derived and not automatically registered in the canonical entity registry.
Economic and market modules lack hypothesis cards, chronology, baselines, uncertainty, and leakage controls.
Sensitive sexual-archetype content requires explicit consent and default exclusion.
The chart synthesis has no complete source chart, birth data, or calculation request.
